name: MonarchDataGrid
title: DataGrid
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn with androidx.compose.foundation.horizontalScroll on one shared ScrollState for the scrolling columns, sized by androidx.compose.foundation.layout.BoxWithConstraints; androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenu for the column menu and row actions; androidx.compose.material3.Checkbox and TriStateCheckbox for selection; androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet for the record editor on phones; MonarchEditableCell for editing
summary: An editable grid of records: fixed-width columns that sort, pin, hide and resize from a menu on their header, cells that edit in place, selection, row actions and loading more rows at the end; on phones a list of records whose editor opens in a sheet.
whenToUse: For spreadsheet-like screens on tablets and with hardware keyboards: many rows, values edited in place, wide data where key columns stay pinned.
whenNotToUse: For read-only records people scan, sort and open, use MonarchDataTable. For a plain long list without columns, use a LazyColumn (virtual-list). For one record, use a form.
api: @Composable public fun <T, K : Any> MonarchDataGrid(label: String, rows: List<T>, columns: List<MonarchDataGridColumn<T>>, rowKey: (T) -> K, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, layout: MonarchDataTableLayout = MonarchDataTableLayout.Automatic, density: MonarchDataGridDensity = MonarchDataGridDensity.Comfortable, sort: MonarchDataTableSort? = null, onSortChange: ((MonarchDataTableSort?) -> Unit)? = null, sortsRows: Boolean = true, selection: Set<K>? = null, onSelectionChange: ((Set<K>) -> Unit)? = null, hiddenColumns: Set<String> = emptySet(), onHiddenColumnsChange: ((Set<String>) -> Unit)? = null, columnOrder: List<String> = emptyList(), pinning: Map<String, MonarchDataGridPin>? = null, onPinningChange: ((Map<String, MonarchDataGridPin>) -> Unit)? = null, columnWidths: Map<String, Dp> = emptyMap(), onColumnWidthsChange: ((Map<String, Dp>) -> Unit)? = null, loading: Boolean = false, rowLabel: ((T) -> String)? = null, rowSelectable: (T) -> Boolean = { true }, rowActions: ((T) -> List<MonarchDataTableRowAction>)? = null, onRowOpen: ((T) -> Unit)? = null, onEndReached: (() -> Unit)? = null, actionsIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, emptyState: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, state: LazyListState = rememberLazyListState(), labels: MonarchDataGridLabels = MonarchDataGridLabels())

public class MonarchDataGridColumn<T>(title: String, id: String = title, width: Dp = Dp.Unspecified, numeric: Boolean = false, sortable: Boolean = true, hideable: Boolean = true, pinnable: Boolean = true, pinned: MonarchDataGridPin? = null, comparator: Comparator<T>? = null, edit: MonarchDataGridEdit<T, *>? = null, value: (T) -> String) { val chooserColumn: MonarchColumnChooserColumn }

public class MonarchDataGridEdit<T, V : Any>(editor: MonarchEditableCellEditor<V>, value: (T) -> V?, onCommit: suspend (row: T, value: V?) -> Unit, editable: (T) -> Boolean = { true }, required: Boolean = false, placeholder: String? = null, validate: ((row: T, value: V?) -> String?)? = null)
public enum class MonarchDataGridPin { Start, End }
public enum class MonarchDataGridDensity { Comfortable, Compact }

public class MonarchDataGridLabels(selectAll: String? = null, selectRow: ((row: String) -> String)? = null, selectedCount: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, rowActions: ((row: String) -> String)? = null, actionsText: String? = null, columnOptions: String? = null, sortAscending: String? = null, sortDescending: String? = null, clearSort: String? = null, pinStart: String? = null, pinEnd: String? = null, unpin: String? = null, hideColumn: String? = null, widen: String? = null, narrow: String? = null, sortedAscending: String? = null, sortedDescending: String? = null, notSorted: String? = null, pinnedStart: String? = null, pinnedEnd: String? = null, editLabel: ((column: String, row: String) -> String)? = null, cell: ((column: String, value: String) -> String)? = null, open: String? = null, editRecord: String? = null, sort: String? = null, done: String? = null, noValue: String? = null, loading: String? = null, emptyTitle: String? = null, emptyMessage: String? = null, editableCell: MonarchEditableCellLabels = MonarchEditableCellLabels())

options.name: label
options.description: Names the grid for TalkBack, such as "Invoices".

options.name: rows
options.description: The rows, in the app's order.

options.name: columns
options.description: Every column in its default order: title, id, width, numeric, sortable, hideable, pinnable, pinned, comparator, edit and the cell text.

options.name: rowKey
options.description: A row's stable, unique key; also the key in selection and the lazy key.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the grid. Bound its height inside a scrolling parent.

options.name: layout
options.description: Table draws the grid, List the records with an editor sheet; Automatic picks the grid from 640dp wide below font scale 1.5.

options.name: density
options.description: Padding above and below cells; Compact keeps 48dp touch targets.

options.name: sort
options.description: The sort: one column and a direction.

options.name: onSortChange
options.description: Called with the new sort, or null for Clear sort. Without it no menu offers sorting.

options.name: sortsRows
options.description: Whether the grid sorts rows itself; false when the server sorts.

options.name: selection
options.description: The selected keys. With onSelectionChange, rows get checkboxes and the header a select-all checkbox.

options.name: onSelectionChange
options.description: Called with the whole new selection.

options.name: hiddenColumns
options.description: Ids of hidden columns.

options.name: onHiddenColumnsChange
options.description: Called by Hide column; without it the menu has no Hide column.

options.name: columnOrder
options.description: Column ids in display order; missing ids follow in their default order.

options.name: pinning
options.description: Every pinned column by id; null uses each column's own pinned value.

options.name: onPinningChange
options.description: Called with every pinned column by Pin to start, Pin to end and Unpin.

options.name: columnWidths
options.description: Widths by column id, replacing the columns' own widths.

options.name: onColumnWidthsChange
options.description: Called by Widen column and Narrow column, in 16dp steps between 96dp and 480dp.

options.name: loading
options.description: Without rows shows placeholder rows; with rows shows an indeterminate progress bar above them.

options.name: rowLabel
options.description: A row's name in spoken labels and in the list layout. By default the first shown cell.

options.name: rowSelectable
options.description: Whether a row has a checkbox.

options.name: rowActions
options.description: A row's actions: an actions column with a menu, and TalkBack actions.

options.name: onRowOpen
options.description: Opens a row: a tap on a read-only cell, or Open details in the record editor.

options.name: onEndReached
options.description: Called when the last row comes into view, and again once more rows arrive.

options.name: actionsIcon
options.description: The actions button's icon; without it the button shows "Actions".

options.name: emptyState
options.description: Replaces the built-in empty state.

options.name: state
options.description: The scroll state of the rows.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including those of the editable cells.

states.name: grid
states.description: A header row on the subtle fill, then a row per record: a checkbox column, start-pinned columns with a line at their inner edge, a band of columns that scrolls sideways together with the header, end-pinned columns and an actions column.

states.name: list
states.description: For phones and large text: a toolbar with select-all and Sort, then one record per row with its name and a "Field value" line per column. Tapping a record with editable cells opens the record editor sheet.

states.name: sorted
states.description: The sorted header shows an arrow mark and its state is "Sorted ascending" or "Sorted descending"; the column menu offers the other direction and Clear sort.

states.name: pinned
states.description: A pinned column stays at its edge while the band scrolls; its header state includes "Pinned to start" or "Pinned to end". Pins that would take more than half the width scroll with the rest.

states.name: editing
states.description: An editable cell opens its MonarchEditableCell editor in place: a text field with Save and Cancel, a menu or the date picker. It shows progress while saving and keeps the editor open with the message when saving fails.

states.name: selected
states.description: The row fills with the accent's subtle fill and its checkbox is checked; the select-all checkbox is on, off or indeterminate.

states.name: loading
states.description: Without rows: placeholder rows named "Loading rows". With rows: an indeterminate progress bar above them.

states.name: empty
states.description: No rows: MonarchEmptyState with "Nothing here yet", or the app's emptyState.

appearance: Rows on the surface fill with a 1dp subtle divider, the header row on the subtle background with muted labels, a default-border line at the inner edge of pinned columns, selected rows on the accent's subtle fill. Numeric cells align to the end with tabular figures; an empty cell shows a muted dash; the first cell is link-coloured when rows open. Every color is a theme role, so dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Compose and Material 3 have no data grid, so Monarch draws one on a LazyColumn with one shared horizontal ScrollState for the columns that are not pinned. It keeps DataTable's types (MonarchDataTableSort, MonarchDataTableRowAction, MonarchDataTableLayout) as the web DataGrid keeps DataTable's column model. On touch, tapping a header opens the column menu (sort, pin, unpin, hide, widen, narrow) instead of sorting at once; the web's drag-to-resize header edge becomes Widen column and Narrow column in 16dp steps, as the web's Alt+Arrow keys do. Phones get the mobile pattern instead of a squeezed grid: a list of records and an editor in a ModalBottomSheet. Each editable column carries a typed MonarchDataGridEdit with its own onCommit instead of the web's one onCellEdit with untyped values; dates are epoch milliseconds in UTC. Not offered: multi-sort, Shift-click range selection, type-to-edit, the WAI-ARIA grid's single tab stop with arrow-key cell movement (Compose's focus system moves between cells instead) and aria-rowcount for rows not yet loaded. There is no iOS entry yet.
accessibility: The grid is a traversal group named by label.
Headers are headings; a header with menu items is a button whose tap action is read as "Column options" and whose state is its sort and its pin, such as "Sorted descending" or "Pinned to end".
A read-only cell is one focusable element read as "Column: value", with "No value" for an empty cell; with onRowOpen it is a button whose action is "Open details".
An editable cell is a MonarchEditableCell named "Column for row", such as "Customer for INV-1".
Row actions are an actions button named "Actions for row" and TalkBack actions on each read-only cell of the row.
Row checkboxes are named "Select row"; the header's select-all checkbox is on, off or indeterminate.
With a hardware keyboard, Space on a cell that does not use it toggles the row's selection and Ctrl+A or Meta+A selects or clears all rows.
In the list layout each record is one element; a record with editable cells has the tap action "Edit" and, with onRowOpen, a TalkBack action "Open details".
Headers, cells, checkboxes and the actions button are at least 48dp tall; checkboxes and the actions button at least 48dp wide.
edgeCases: Pinned columns that would take more than half of the grid's width scroll with the others, so a narrow screen is never filled by pinned columns.
Each column has a fixed width; long text wraps in its cell and the row grows.
Rows sort by the column's comparator or its text; empty cells sort last in both directions; a sort on an unknown column leaves the app's order.
rowKey values must be unique and savable in a Bundle; the same key twice breaks the lazy list.
onEndReached fires once each time the last row comes into view and again after the number of rows changes, so a short page that leaves the end in view loads the next page.
A column whose edit says a row is not editable shows that row's cell as read-only text, not a disabled control.
The record editor finds its row by key on each change, so values saved in the sheet show at once; when the row disappears the sheet closes.

examples.title: 10,000 editable invoices
examples.template:
MonarchDataGrid(
    label = {{label}},
    rows = rows,
    columns = columns,
    rowKey = { it.id },
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(420.dp),
    layout = MonarchDataTableLayout.Table,
    sort = sort,
    onSortChange = { sort = it },
    selection = selected,
    onSelectionChange = { selected = it },
    rowActions = { row ->
        listOf(
            MonarchDataTableRowAction({{rowActions.0}}) {},
            MonarchDataTableRowAction({{rowActions.1}}, danger = true) { rows = rows.filterNot { it.id == row.id } },
        )
    },
)
examples.setupTemplate:
data class Invoice(val id: String, val number: String, val customer: String, val status: String, val amount: Double, val due: String)
val customers = listOf({{customers.0}}, {{customers.1}}, {{customers.2}}, {{customers.3}})
val statuses = listOf({{statuses.0}}, {{statuses.1}}, {{statuses.2}}, {{statuses.3}})
var rows by remember {
    mutableStateOf(
        (0 until {{rowCount}}).map { i ->
            Invoice(
                id = "inv-$i",
                number = "INV-" + "%05d".format(i + 1),
                customer = customers[i % customers.size],
                status = statuses[i % statuses.size],
                amount = ((i * 7919) % 50_000) / 100.0,
                due = "2026-" + "%02d".format(i % 12 + 1) + "-" + "%02d".format(i % 27 + 1),
            )
        },
    )
}
var sort by remember { mutableStateOf<MonarchDataTableSort?>(null) }
var selected by remember { mutableStateOf(emptySet<String>()) }
val columns = listOf<MonarchDataGridColumn<Invoice>>(
    MonarchDataGridColumn({{columns.0.header}}, id = {{columns.0.id}}, width = {{columns.0.width}}.dp, hideable = false, pinned = MonarchDataGridPin.Start) { it.number },
    MonarchDataGridColumn(
        {{columns.1.header}},
        id = {{columns.1.id}},
        width = {{columns.1.width}}.dp,
        edit = MonarchDataGridEdit(
            editor = MonarchEditableCellEditor.Text,
            value = { it.customer },
            onCommit = { row, value -> rows = rows.map { if (it.id == row.id) it.copy(customer = value.orEmpty()) else it } },
            required = true,
        ),
    ) { it.customer },
    MonarchDataGridColumn(
        {{columns.2.header}},
        id = {{columns.2.id}},
        width = {{columns.2.width}}.dp,
        edit = MonarchDataGridEdit(
            editor = MonarchEditableCellEditor.Select(statuses.map { MonarchSelectOption(it, it) }),
            value = { it.status },
            onCommit = { row, value -> rows = rows.map { if (it.id == row.id) it.copy(status = value.orEmpty()) else it } },
        ),
    ) { it.status },
    MonarchDataGridColumn(
        {{columns.3.header}},
        id = {{columns.3.id}},
        width = {{columns.3.width}}.dp,
        numeric = true,
        edit = MonarchDataGridEdit(
            editor = MonarchEditableCellEditor.Number(min = 0.0),
            value = { it.amount },
            onCommit = { row, value -> rows = rows.map { if (it.id == row.id) it.copy(amount = value ?: it.amount) else it } },
        ),
    ) { "%.2f".format(it.amount) },
    MonarchDataGridColumn({{columns.4.header}}, id = {{columns.4.id}}, width = {{columns.4.width}}.dp) { it.due },
)

examples.title: A grid that pins, hides and resizes from its column menus
examples.code:
MonarchDataGrid(
    label = "Invoices",
    rows = rows,
    columns = columns,
    rowKey = { it[0] },
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
    layout = MonarchDataTableLayout.Table,
    density = MonarchDataGridDensity.Compact,
    hiddenColumns = hidden,
    onHiddenColumnsChange = { hidden = it },
    pinning = pinning,
    onPinningChange = { pinning = it },
    columnWidths = widths,
    onColumnWidthsChange = { widths = it },
    rowActions = { listOf(MonarchDataTableRowAction("Void", danger = true) {}) },
    onEndReached = { /* Load the next page here. */ },
)

parityExceptions.reason: The web grid is 614px wide, so Invoice, Customer and part of Status show beside the pinned actions column. The phone window is 344dp wide: the pinned Invoice column and the selection column leave room for part of Customer, and Status, Amount and Due are reached by scrolling sideways, as on the web. The row actions button scrolls with the row on Android and is pinned at the end on the web. The columns, rows, order and copy are the web's.
parityExceptions.convention: Material adaptive layout: a compact window shows fewer columns
